cases.row: Alpha: clip mask stack (v22 rectangle/ellipse/path, static and keyframed)
cases.description: A static rectangle mask, then a keyframed ellipse over a subtracted path and a disabled mask, over a base.

cases.row: Alpha: mask stack combine modes (add/subtract/intersect/difference/lighten/darken; rectangle, ellipse and path)
cases.description: One clip per combine mode, each a feathered rotated rounded rectangle combined with a feathered ellipse or curved path, over a base.

cases.row: Alpha: mask edges (invert, expansion, inner/outer feather, three falloffs, per-vertex feather)
cases.description: Invert with expansion, shrink with inner and outer gaussian feather, per-vertex feather on a path, and hard sub-pixel edges.

cases.row: Alpha: effect-target masks (a grade limited to a keyframed ellipse minus a rectangle, under an alpha cut)
cases.description: A colour grade applied only inside a moving feathered ellipse with a subtracted hole, on a clip also cut by an alpha ellipse.

cases.row: Alpha: a clip blur limited to a keyframed mask (face blur), after an unmasked grade
cases.description: A clip blur (render/clip_blur.py) applied only inside a moving feathered ellipse, on a clip that also carries a whole-clip grade: grade first, then the masked blur, the order the export applies them.

cases.row: Alpha: gaussian-legacy masks (feathered rectangle, inverted ellipse, polygon in a stack)
cases.description: Masks migrated from v21 keep the Pillow rasteriser and blur: alone (float alpha) and inside a two-mask stack.

cases.row: Alpha: opacity keyframes
cases.description: A front layer fading from opaque to transparent over a base.

cases.row: Alpha: matte mask (BR2) read at the picture's decoded source frame
cases.description: Video, text, then a matted copy of the same video (text behind subject); the copy is ramped so its matte frame follows the speed curve, and an inverted matte limits a grade.

cases.row: Alpha: matte edgeMode sharp and smooth with edge shift (BR5)
cases.description: A moving hard-edged matte with one-pixel strands over another source: sharp edge mode with a fractional grow, then smooth with a shrink.

cases.row: Alpha: matte decontaminate on and off (BR5)
cases.description: The same matte with decontamination (edge band recoloured with the foreground estimate) and without; the estimate is not the picture's colour, so the band differs.

cases.row: Alpha: matte x shape mask stack (BR5)
cases.description: A matte minus a feathered rectangle (a light stand), intersected with an ellipse, on a cropped clip; a second clip's inverted matte limits a grade.

cases.row: Alpha: matte on a speed-ramped and reversed clip (BR5)
cases.description: The matte frame follows the picture's source frame through a three-point ramp and a reversed clip.

cases.row: Alpha: matte on a variable-frame-rate source (BR5)
cases.description: frames.json carries the VFR source's own pts; the matte frame is the picture's frame at 1x and 2x.

cases.row: Alpha: matte in rotated and anamorphic display space (BR5)
cases.description: Artifacts at display size: 1920x1080 for a 4:3-pixel 1440x1080 source, 1080x1920 for the same rotated 90 degrees.

cases.row: Alpha: progressive partially processed matte (BR5)
cases.description: A job still running: the preview's artifact holds only the first frames. A processed frame is matted; a later one shows the original picture (the layer left out), never a neighbouring matte frame.

cases.row: Alpha: key mask on the GPU path (PX5.6)
cases.description: An inverted HSL key cuts a green backdrop out of a numpy-made picture over video; the second clip also despills green, so the limiter runs after the cut.

cases.row: Alpha: key x shape mask stack (PX5.6)
cases.description: An inverted key intersected with an ellipse window minus a feathered rectangle: the key combines with shapes in the float accumulator and is quantised once.

cases.row: Alpha: key with the whole finesse chain (PX5.6)
cases.description: An inverted key through denoise, clean levels, morph open/close, shrink, blur and in/out ratio, at partial opacity.

cases.row: Alpha: split and mirror band masks (MK8.1)
cases.description: A soft diagonal split, then a subtracted feathered band with a keyframed angle over a split, on a clip over a base.

cases.row: Alpha: gradient masks, linear and radial, alpha and effect target (MK8.1)
cases.description: A linear smooth gradient fades a clip into the base; a radial gaussian gradient limits a grade on a second clip, intersected with a split.

cases.row: Alpha: text as a mask — a title as a clip's alpha track matte (MK8.2)
cases.description: A large white title on the top track is the alpha matte of a clip below it: the clip shows through the letters over the base, and the title itself is not drawn.

cases.row: Alpha: luma and inverted-luma track mattes from a clip and from a track (MK8.2)
cases.description: A numpy-made grey ramp (lossless PNG source) is the luma matte of one clip, then, read as a whole track, the inverted-luma matte of the next.

cases.row: Alpha: inverted-alpha track matte of a masked clip onto a scaled and a rotated clip (MK8.2)
cases.description: A clip cut to an ellipse is the inverted-alpha matte of a scaled, offset clip, stacked with a rectangle; then a title is the alpha matte of a rotating clip.

cases.row: Alpha: frame-space clip masks on moving, scaled and rotated pictures (MK9.1)
cases.description: A scaled, moving portrait clip cut by a frame-space rectangle minus a frame-space band, then a rotating clip whose source ellipse is intersected with a frame-space gradient.

cases.row: Alpha: cut-out edge styles around a shape mask (MK9.2 stroke, glow, shadow)
cases.description: An ellipse cut-out with an outline, then a glow, then a drop shadow, then all three on a scaled clip, over a base.

cases.row: Alpha: cut-out edge styles around an AI matte (MK9.2 stroke, glow, shadow)
cases.description: A background-removal matte with an outline, then a glow, then a drop shadow, then all three on a scaled clip, over a base.
